title: Keep distributable skills runtime-only
statement: When changing a distributable skill, keep development-only tests and maintainer design records outside its skill directory; review existing resources before relocation and preserve any operational requirements in SKILL.md or a linked runtime reference.
anti_pattern: shipping development-only tests or design records inside an installed skill
moving a resource based on its filename without reviewing its runtime content
safe_path: classify each resource as runtime-required or development-only
move development-only tests and maintainer records to repository-level tests or docs
distill any operational requirements into SKILL.md or a linked runtime reference
verify the installed file list and run skill validation
exceptions: references, scripts, assets, and metadata directly used by the runtime workflow remain inside the skill
